instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: That is not a language that I recognise.
atoms.b: That is not a language that I ((recognise)).

atoms.a: I believe it is important to have the ability to empathise with others.
atoms.b: I believe it is important to have the ability to ((empathise)) with others.

atoms.a: Starting at a young age, it is important to emphasise reading.
atoms.b: Starting at a young age it is important to ((emphasise)) reading.

atoms.a: I can sympathise with you because I also have food poisoning.
atoms.b: I can ((sympathise)) with you because I also have food poisoning.

atoms.a: It is rumoured that vampires have the power to mesmerise their victims.
atoms.b: It is rumoured that vampires have the power to ((mesmerise)) their victims.

atoms.a: You can buy sunglasses with a coating to minimise the glare from the sun.
atoms.b: You can buy sunglasses with a coating to ((minimise)) the glare from the sun.
